name: Wand of Paralysis
description: A wand of smooth grey stone, cold enough to numb the fingers.
body:
## What it does

Spend a charge to send a thin blue ray at a creature within 60 feet. It makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or is paralyzed for a minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

## Charges

It holds seven and regains 1d6 + 1 each dawn. Spend the last and it may crumble to ash.
